qualification: Discovery observations only. Final acceptance uses unchanged-source final ledgers. Missing exploratory raw artifacts are explicitly not reconstructed.

findings.finding: Recursive exclusion of None strips a required null finite result; storing optional finite_items:null also breaks strict legacy response replay.
findings.decision: Use unset omission and omit the finite extension entirely for legacy response construction and journal storage.

findings.finding: Receipt outcome initially included a temporary created_at/self-digest, preventing independent reproduction from the returned persisted receipt.
findings.decision: Canonical outcome binds manifest/flow/phase/key/task/operation/attempt/result digest, excluding timestamps/self-digest; verify persisted result size/SHA and outcome on every authority read. Independent HTTP digest assertions pass in the final finite profile.

findings.finding: A lost completion acknowledgement followed by a late Failed could advance an attempt after an immutable success receipt.
findings.decision: Keep attempt exactness; reject lifecycle advancement and discard late failure events after receipt. Actual HTTP and real-recorder controls include both former-holder and current-holder future-timestamp Failed events.

findings.finding: First expanded HTTP discovery used an already-imported test module before missing helper imports were corrected; NameError(timedelta).
findings.decision: Add the required imports and preserve the failed trial.

findings.finding: The next recorder test tried to start a replacement task before its normal FlowRun Running transition. The server correctly refused inactive authority.
findings.decision: Enter Running through the ordinary Flow API before the retry TaskRun transition; preserve the refusal trial.

findings.finding: Server author reported SQLite38pass+regex-case assertion failure; PG38pass+same assertion failure; model2pass+transaction-catch assertion failure.
findings.decision: Test assertions corrected. These transcript-reported observations have no saved raw log/XML and are not used as acceptance evidence. Final76-source PG/SQLite/model gates are separate recorded runs.

findings.finding: Standalone SQLite API probe initially lacked the repository root on its import path for the captured RestartableAPI helper.
findings.decision: Set command-local PYTHONPATH=/workspace/ariadne; the unchanged captured probe then passed against migrated SQLite with zero data-plane rows.
